name: de.fidonis/qdrant-ingest
title: Qdrant Ingest
description: Scheduled multi-source document ingestion into an existing Qdrant. Primarily an ingestion daemon; the MCP tools are its control surface (list jobs, trigger a reindex, inspect runs) and need a reachable Qdrant, embeddings endpoint, and Tika server to do anything.

environmentVariables.name: QI_QDRANT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Qdrant api-key; the ingester writes points and collection metadata directly

environmentVariables.name: QI_EMBEDDING_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible embeddings base URL, e.g. http://litellm:4000/v1

environmentVariables.name: QI_EMBEDDING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the embeddings endpoint

environmentVariables.name: QI_TIKA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Apache Tika server used for text extraction, e.g. http://tika:9998

environmentVariables.name: QI_JOBS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the mounted jobs.yaml job catalog, e.g. /config/jobs.yaml

environmentVariables.name: OIDC_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: OIDC issuer / realm URL used to validate MCP bearer tokens

environmentVariables.name: QI_OIDC_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Expected aud claim of incoming MCP access tokens

environmentVariables.name: QI_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required on every REST /v1 call
